templates.title: Poster
templates.prompt: A poster with one strong picture and large, clear type. Keep the layout simple enough to read from across a room, and use only the wording given.
templates.tile: A screen-printed concert poster for a made-up band called NIGHT HERON, a heron standing in reeds under a huge orange moon, bold condensed lettering, three flat ink colours, on a warm terracotta backdrop

templates.title: Interior design
templates.prompt: A room, shown as a finished interior. Keep the furniture in proportion and the light believable, and follow the style, size and budget described.
templates.tile: An isometric cutaway of a small sunlit reading room with a green armchair, tall bookshelves, a rug and a hanging plant, soft clay render style, floating on a lilac backdrop

templates.title: Logo
templates.prompt: A logo mark that stays recognisable small and large. Use flat shapes and at most two colours, and spell any name exactly as given.
templates.tile: A flat one-colour logo mark of a paper boat inside a circle, thick even lines, deep teal on a pale blue-grey backdrop, centred, no lettering

templates.title: Illustration
templates.prompt: An illustration in one consistent style. Tell the scene clearly, keep the colours to a small palette, and leave lettering out unless asked.
templates.tile: A warm gouache illustration of a child in a yellow raincoat and a shaggy dog sharing an umbrella, soft textured brushwork, on a lavender backdrop

templates.title: Portrait
templates.prompt: A portrait with soft, even light and a plain backdrop. Keep the face natural and unretouched, framed from the shoulders up.
templates.tile: A studio portrait photo of a man in his sixties with a grey beard and round glasses, wearing a navy sweater, soft window light, plain warm grey backdrop, shoulders up, natural skin

templates.title: Icon set
templates.prompt: A small set of icons drawn to one grid, with one line weight and one colour, so they read as a family.
templates.tile: Four simple rounded icons in a two by two grid, a kite, a teapot, a cactus and a comet, cream coloured flat shapes on a deep teal backdrop, even spacing

templates.title: Product photo
templates.prompt: A product on a clean set, lit like a studio photo. Keep the product true to its description and the background quiet.
templates.tile: A studio product photo of a ribbed glass bottle of hand soap with a brass pump on a pale pink set, soft shadow, morning light, minimal styling

templates.title: Merch
templates.prompt: A design shown on merchandise, such as a shirt, tote or mug. Keep the artwork inside the printable area and the item realistic.
templates.tile: A white tote bag hanging from a wooden peg, printed with a playful drawing of an octopus juggling oranges, against a bright blue wall, product photo

templates.title: Infographic
templates.prompt: An infographic that explains one idea in a few labelled steps. Use the facts given and nothing else, with short labels.
templates.tile: A clean infographic style drawing of the water cycle with a mountain, a river, the sea and clouds joined by three curved arrows, flat shapes, soft blue palette, no lettering

templates.title: Flyer
templates.prompt: A flyer for an event or notice. Lead with the headline, then the date and place, using only the details given.
templates.tile: A photocopied street flyer pinned to a cork board that reads PLANT SWAP in heavy black letters above a black and white photo of a potted fern, and SATURDAY 10 AM below it, on a charcoal backdrop

templates.title: Book cover
templates.prompt: A book cover with the title and author set clearly. Suggest the mood of the story without showing its plot.
templates.tile: A hardback novel standing upright, its cover a painted lighthouse on a cliff at dusk with the title THE LONG TIDE in elegant serif capitals, on a soft blue backdrop

templates.title: Album cover
templates.prompt: A square album cover. Let one image carry the mood, and keep any title small and exactly as given.
templates.tile: A square album cover with an abstract iridescent liquid chrome shape in violet, lime and black, slightly blurred, with small type reading SLOW ORBIT in one corner, on a pale violet backdrop

templates.title: Packaging
templates.prompt: Packaging for a product, shown as the finished box, bag or bottle. Keep the label wording exactly as given.
templates.tile: A small paper box of loose leaf tea with a minimal label reading FERN and a simple green leaf drawing, standing on a peach backdrop, soft studio light

templates.title: Ad
templates.prompt: An advert with one message and one clear call to act. Use only the wording given and leave room around it.
templates.tile: An advert style photo of a hand holding a bright orange sparkling drink can against a hot pink backdrop, with hand lettered words TRY IT COLD in the corner

templates.title: Social post
templates.prompt: A picture sized for a social post, with a short line of text that reads at phone size.
templates.tile: A social media post layout, a photo of a breakfast table from above with coffee and toast, large rounded white words SLOW MORNINGS across the middle, on a sage green backdrop

trending.title: Risograph print
trending.prompt: A two-colour risograph print of a bicycle leaning on a fruit stall, with visible grain and slightly misaligned layers.

trending.title: Clay diorama
trending.prompt: A tiny handmade clay diorama of a ramen shop at night, photographed close with soft daylight.

trending.title: Blueprint
trending.prompt: A technical blueprint drawing of a paper aeroplane, white lines on deep blue, with measured labels.

trending.title: Paper cut
trending.prompt: A layered paper-cut scene of a fox in a birch forest, with soft shadows between the layers.

trending.title: Linocut
trending.prompt: A black linocut print of a sailing boat in rough sea on cream paper, with bold carved lines.

trending.title: Wooden toy
trending.prompt: A close-up photo of a wooden toy version of a city tram on a plain table.

trending.title: Watercolour map
trending.prompt: A hand-painted watercolour map of an imaginary island, with small labels and a compass rose.

trending.title: Neon night
trending.prompt: A photo of a corner bookshop at night, lit only by pink and blue neon signs on wet streets.
